findings.title: findMany method removed without updating callers
findings.body: The public `findMany(findManyArgs)` method on InsightsBookingService was deleted and replaced with `getBaseConditions()`, which returns a raw `Prisma.Sql` fragment. Any existing caller that invoked `service.findMany({ select: ... })` against the BookingTimeStatusDenormalized model (the previous test did exactly this, and it was the service's only query execution path) will now fail to compile or, worse, the service no longer has any method that actually executes a query — consumers must now hand-build `$queryRaw` SQL themselves and correctly interpolate the conditions into a WHERE clause. The PR only changes this file and its test, so either callers elsewhere in the repo are now broken, or the migration of callers is missing from this PR.

findings.title: Caching behavior tests removed while caching logic remains
findings.body: The two tests that verified `getAuthorizationConditions()` and `getFilterConditions()` return cached results on repeated calls were deleted, but the service still implements caching via `cachedAuthConditions` / `cachedFilterConditions` (insightsBooking.ts lines 49-50, 84-95). There is now no test coverage for the memoization behavior. Additionally, the PR description itself states the author could not run the test suite ('test runner had configuration issues'), so none of the rewritten SQL-expectation assertions — which are tightly coupled to exact SQL string output — have been verified to pass.
